learner_words: Jo showed me the trick with the slushy sounds. I kept saying them backwards.
guide_note: Wednesday, mid-morning. Both kids were at the table at the same time which is always a gamble. Pip was working through Word Chain Race and got stuck on two blends where she was flipping the sound order — saying something like 'lf' instead of 'fl'. Jo, who had already finished their session, leaned over and quietly walked her through it with a little hand motion trick they made up. I let it happen. Pip got 11 of 14 and made it to level 2. She needed more breaks than Jo and I had to remind her twice to focus, but she pushed through. Nice sibling moment.
